source: Orchestrator data (protocol §2). file: spec v2 'The disclosure file' (the B4 Uni defaults, buzz-school disclosure.v1.json), equal to the disclosure-v2 mockup's DISCLOSURE. Every school stores no override (the mockup sets no discO); Harbor Arts Academy is large for 2026 and the others small (mockup bkSize: the last closed year's income against largeFrom). viewer: the mockup's signed-in person (SC.<id>.R you:true) with audOf's audience and youSub's View as row. viewAs: the mockup's SUBS rows with vaAllowed, vaSummary and VW's books audience for Admin. views: worked out at the clock 2026-11-05 from the file with the mockup's (atm dev 742105b64) pAllow, pList, vaSummary, renderPP and whoTxt; locks in the v2 vocabulary (hidWho, lockPanel). Generated once by the S7 gate author; the UI reads it as given.
